description: Create PDFs from Word documents or text, and read/extract text content from existing PDF files. Supports conversion, text extraction, and AI summarization of PDF content.

operation.description: What to do: 'read' extracts text, 'summarize' gives AI summary, 'convert_from_word' converts .docx to .pdf, 'create_from_text' makes a PDF from plain text

filepath.description: Path to the PDF or Word file to process

content.description: For 'create_from_text': the text content to put in the PDF

output_path.description: Where to save the output PDF. Defaults to Desktop.

example_commands: convert my Word doc to PDF
read me the first 3 pages of the PDF
